ThingDef.label: giant bones
ThingDef.description: Enormous remnants of some kind of creature, valued for their durability and often used in crafting sturdy weapons and specialized tools..

ThingDef.label: thick unhold fur
ThingDef.description: Warm furs of the formidable unhold, renowned for their thickness and weatherproof nature, sought after for crafting resilient garments and protective gear.

ThingDef.label: unhold hide
ThingDef.description: Robust hides of the formidable unhold, renowned for their thickness and weatherproof nature, sought after for crafting resilient garments and protective gear.

ThingDef.label: unhold heart
ThingDef.description: The beating heart of the fearsome unhold, pulsing with primal power and ancient vitality, considered to be a key ingredient for creating elixirs of endurance.

ThingDef.label: lindwurm blood
ThingDef.description: The acidic blood of a Lindwurm, carefully preserved in glass. Highly corrosive in nature, it can melt through plate armor in a matter of seconds. Due to it’s offensive capabilities, it is highly sought for by alchemists and hunters.

ThingDef.label: lindwurm broad scales
ThingDef.description: Tough, durable scales shed from a Lindwurm, prized for their exceptional strength and resilience. Ideal for crafting high-quality armor and protective gear.

ThingDef.label: parched skin
ThingDef.description: Soft yet durable hide from an Alp, often used to craft lightweight armor or clothing with subtle protective qualities.

ThingDef.label: petrified scream
ThingDef.description: A unique part of Alp biology, this solidified manifestation of the creature's final cry is a rare and eerie material used in crafting or dark rituals.

ThingDef.label: third eye
ThingDef.description: A mystical organ from an Alp, known for its ability to perceive beyond the physical realm. Often sought after for use in powerful rituals or crafting items with enhanced perception or psychic abilities.

ThingDef.label: adrenaline gland
ThingDef.description: This organ significantly enhances the body's fight-or-flight response, increasing strength, speed, and reaction time when activated. Often used in crafting potent combat stimulants.
